source.reference_note: Historical numeric-equivalence reference; current revision is recorded, not blocked.
source.evidence: Conditional sample-domain behavioral experiment; no claim of measured device-noise transfer or whole RTL performance signoff.
source.generation_command: PYTHONPATH=src OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python tools/reproduce_randomization_caaz.py --out NEW_DIRECTORY

assumptions.grade: ASSUMED experiment stress; not process data or the default mismatch sigma
assumptions.rate_grade: ENGINEERING_CHOICE; source prototype raw/effective rate remains unresolved

metric_definitions.pair_signal_reference: (x_even+x_odd)/2 from known source aperture times; not latest endpoint or unfiltered midpoint.
metric_definitions.mean_v: Arithmetic mean signed error in V.
metric_definitions.std_v: Population standard deviation about the error mean in V; removes DC error.
metric_definitions.rms_v: sqrt(mean(error**2)) in V; retains DC error and is not interchangeable with std.
metric_definitions.quiet_pair_error: CAAZ with zero added AZ error, minus the two-aperture signal reference; ordinary mismatch/quantization remains.
metric_definitions.ordinary_pair_error: No input chopping, ordinary pair average, minus the same two-aperture reference.
metric_definitions.delta_noise_all: Same chip/controls/RNG: noisy paired20bit output minus quiet paired20bit output, retaining all raw flags.
metric_definitions.linear_prediction_Khat: e_pair*(H_even/Khat_even-H_odd/Khat_odd)/2; Khat derives only from frozen digital coefficients/masks.
metric_definitions.linear_prediction_physical_K: Same formula with diagnostic physical K=G*alpha. Truth is plant/oracle-only, never a calibration feature.
metric_definitions.quantization_bound_v: 1.5 LSB20 + ADC2step/min(Khat), for the difference of two pair outputs in the unsaturated static regime.
metric_definitions.quantization_difference_floor: Nonzero noisy-minus-quiet code RMS can remain even when continuous shared AZ leakage is zero; ADC2 and final word quantization are nonlinear. It is not evidence of a device-noise conflict.
metric_definitions.valid_intersection: Statistics with this suffix explicitly use pairs valid in both captures; all-pair statistics and arrays are separately retained.
metric_definitions.G: Residue gain C_signal/Cf, dimensionless. Sampling dither signal gain is K=G*alpha, not G alone.
metric_definitions.H_AZ: A uses constant Gnom and B uses physical G_n; both multiply the same assumed input-equivalent e innovations. The paper does not supply the transfer of this project18-slice amplifier.

mismatch.training_data_source: only DigitalObservation + separately evaluated known reference; no G/C/alpha/oracle passed to fit
